_comment: Provenance for every PDF in this directory. Nothing here is synthetic: each entry records where the deed was published and how its ward was determined. `ward_name` is cross-checked at ingest time by point-in-polygon against data/fixtures/spatial/sheffield_28_wards_ons_boundaries.geojson.

deeds.site_name: Land at junction with Carr Road and Hollin Busk Lane, Deepcar, Sheffield S36 1GH
deeds.ward_source: postcodes.io S36 1GH centroid (53.482286, -1.607358) resolved against the ONS 2013 ward boundary layer
deeds.dwellings_source: deed recital and appeal CD6.13: outline permission for up to 85 dwellings including open space
deeds.source_note: Final engrossment (V4) of the section 106 deed, published as appeal exhibit CD8.6a for appeal APP/J4423/W/21/3267168 (DLP on behalf of Hallam Land Management v Sheffield City Council). Indexation clause 5 names the RPI All Items index, ONS item reference CHAW - the same series loaded from data/fixtures/inflation/.

known_unavailable.description: Two further Sheffield City Council section 106 agreements (planning references 05/01134/REM and 06/00412/FUL) were released by the Council under an EIR request and are published on WhatDoTheyKnow as '000008275 S106 Agreement 531 Redacted.pdf' (1.9 MB) and '000005063 S106 Agreement 548 Redacted.pdf' (1.1 MB).
known_unavailable.why_not_committed: whatdotheyknow.com rejects scripted attachment downloads (HTTP 418). Download them in a browser and drop them in this directory, then add a manifest entry.
